newsitem.title: POLAND: Bourse suspends Espebepe trade April 14.
newsitem.headline: Bourse suspends Espebepe trade April 14.

text.p: The Warsaw Stock Exchange will suspend on Monday, April 14, trade in shares in Espebepe construction firm, which is due to hold a meeting with its creditors on that day, bourse president Wieslaw Rozlucki said on Friday.

Espebepe, burdened with a 75 million zloty ($24.1 million) debt, is seeking a 95-percent debt reduction but one of its main creditors -- Pomorski Bank Kredytowy SA -- said on Thursday it would not accept such a deep write-off.
Espebepe's management has long signalled that without such a deep debt reduction the company would have to file for bankruptcy.
